description: Prerequisite: caller's moderation level strictly higher than the target's. Effect: sends ArchiveModerationRequest{REJECT_USER, EntityId=target_user_id} on the city socket. Server pushes VerificationNotification{IsVerified=false} to the target's live sessions and closes them. Does NOT ban the user — they can retry verification. Cost: none. No persistent DB mutation (unlike approve). No response PDU. Note: EntityId is a user_id, NOT an avatar_id. Non-admin callers refused in the bot handler.

args.name: target_user_id
args.description: fso_users.user_id of the pending user. This is NOT an avatar_id.

call_signatures: cf $CF archive-reject-user --target_user_id <user_id>                                # admin-only; target is USER_ID not avatar_id; close session
common_mistakes: Same user_id trap — NOT an avatar_id.
Rejected user's session is closed with VerificationNotification{IsVerified=false}.
perception_hints: Target persist_id: perception.nearby_sims[].persist_id (for physically-present targets); other avatars need find-avatar or direct knowledge of avatar_id
Your own persist_id (to avoid self-target): perception.avatar.persist_id
Chat activity you may want to moderate: perception.recent_events[] kind=='chat'
refuse_conditions: target_user_id missing or <= 0 → ok:false (NOTE: user_id, not avatar_id)
